name: Penalty List Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of report for the penalties.

CURR.name: Current
CURR.definition: To report the new penalties and the modified penalties in one single message /report.

FWAM.name: Forward Amend
FWAM.definition: To report a penalty list that has been amended (that is the penalty list contains only updated and/or removed penalties that have already been previously reported in a FWIS Penalty List).

FWIS.name: Forward Initial Submission
FWIS.definition: To report a daily penalty list created for the first time (that is the penalty list contains only newly computed penalties)
